newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sero eyes 23 pct jump in sales, takes stake.
newsitem.headline: Sero eyes 23 pct jump in sales, takes stake.

text.p: German waste management group Sero AG, which floated its shares on the bourse last year, on Monday said it planned to post a 23 percent rise in group sales in the 1996/1997 business year.
In a mandatory statement the group said business has met expectations so far and that sales should reach 210 million marks ($128.4 million) by the end of the business year ending on June 30.
The group also said it has taken a 75 percent stake in scrap metal group DOR-Metall. The remaining stake is held by the group's two partners.
